run_vis_ann_parsed: run the vis_ann_parsed CLI to visualize COCO annotations on images with bounding boxes and segmentations
convert_polygons_to_bitmask: convert COCO polygon segmentation data to a boolean bitmask array for a given image height and width
visualize_coco_segmentations: visualize COCO instance segmentations overlaid on images with colored masks and category labels
draw_bounding_boxes_with_labels: draw colored bounding boxes and category labels on images from COCO annotation data
sample_and_render_annotatations: sample COCO images at a given interval and render annotated images to an output directory
